title: THE FUTURE CONTINUOUS TENSE
overview: The future continuous tense isn't taught very much in English classes but, in fact, English speakers use it a lot. You will sound much more natural if you master this tense. Click here to download this explanation as a PDF. Click here to learn about how to USE this tense. Click here for our complete programme to perfect your English grammar. Here's how to make it: The positive (will + be + verb-ing): At 10 am tomorrow, I will be sleeping you will be working she will be studying it will be raining he will be cooking we will be eating breakfast they will be travelling In the same way as with the future simple, usually we use the short form ('ll be verb-ing) when we are speaking.
